entities.description: A close-up shot showing the lower face of a smiling adult man with stubble and the full face of a baby with large dark eyes and chubby cheeks, positioned closely together. The man is wearing a light-colored shirt, and the baby is looking slightly to the side with a neutral expression.

The baby has large, dark eyes with long eyelashes, a small nose, and slightly parted lips, with chubby cheeks and a soft, smooth complexion.
